thread:
maria: Heads up — kicking off a staging base-image rebuild to address a high-severity glibc CVE discovered in the signed base layer. Target canary window: tomorrow 01:30 UTC. Pausing autoscale during the bake to avoid noisy churn.

dan: Which exact tag are we rebuilding? runtime-base:v2024-09-12 or the more recent nightlies? Any RBAC changes needed for the signing flow?

sec-bot: scan results attached: CVE-2024-XXXX - glibc <2.34 - severity: HIGH. Affected layer: /usr/lib in base layer. Repro: `docker run --rm scanner runtime-base:v2024-09-12`.

jess: We should do cosign + KMS signing for the canary images. Who has access to the dev keystore / keystore-dev? @ops-oncall can we get a short-lived signer? :thinking_face:

ops-oncall: I can provision a short-lived signer SA. Plan: create `canary-signer@infra` SA bound to `roles/kms.signer` on keystore-dev for the window and write an audit entry. Will also add an allowlist entry so only the image-build pipeline can use it.

sam: Quick runbook snippet for the image job (will run in kapp-ci):
```bash
# build & sign
docker build -t gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:canary-1754321000 .
docker push gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:canary-1754321000
# cosign using KMS
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/dev/cryptoKeys/cosign --annotations staging=rebuild-1754321000 gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:canary-1754321000
```
Make sure the job uses `securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
` and the image Dockerfile has `USER 1000`.

maria: For RBAC: we need a PR that adds the `canary-signer` subject to the `image-signers` binding for dev only, with an expiration annotation. Also bump audit log retention for staging image events to 90d for this incident window.

dan: If the cosign/KMS step fails, what's our fallback? Do we allow unsigned images into staging or abort pipeline?

jess: Pipeline policy: fail the build on signing failures. Fallback plan: if signing is flaky, route traffic to previous signed image and open an incident ticket; do not promote unsigned images. We have a router policy to fallback to `runtime-base:stable` for staging traffic.

sec-bot: created tracking issue: https://go/repo/issue/SEC-175432 — added scan output and suggested remediation steps.

maria: Runtime security checklist for the rebuild: remove CAP_NET_ADMIN from runtime entrypoint, ensure `USER 1000`, verify seccomp profile applied, and strip setuid bits. Add CKV checks in the CI stage.

sam: I'll kick off the rebuild job in ~30m in a canary namespace `staging-canary-1`. Will post job logs here.

ops-oncall: Provisioned `canary-signer` SA and granted `roles/kms.signer` on keystore-dev until 1754322000. Audit tag added: `staging-rebuild-1754321000`. I also created a short-lived key access log group with 7d retention forwarded to Splunk index `sec-audit-staging`.

maria: Awesome. Assigning tasks: @sam run the bake & post logs, @jess handle cosign + KMS verification, @dan submit RBAC PR with expiration annotation, @ops-oncall confirm audit entries and remove access after window. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Will do.

sam: Started job: `k apply -f jobs/rebuild-canary-1754321000.yaml` — logs streaming, first layer built.

maria: Thanks — keep notes in SEC-175432 and ping infra if anything weird pops up.
